title: Baagi ba Dipilara tse di kwa Godimo
intro: O eme fa pele ga marope a motse o o tlotlegang wa bogologolo, dipilara tsa one tse di kwa godimo jaanong di ole. Phefo e bokolela mo mebileng e e senang sepe, e tshotse kgakologelo ya batho ba ba nonofileng ba ba kileng ba bo ba busa mafatshe ano. E ne e le bomang?
clues: Re ne re le batho ba ba nang le maatla le bokgoni jo bogolo thata, re itsege ka dikago tsa rona tse dikgolo le tlhabologo e e gatetseng pele.
Re ne re nna mo lefatsheng la dithota tsa motlhaba le dithota tsa matlapa, mme re ne re dumela gore ga go na ope yo o neng a ka re fenya.
Morongwa o ne a tla kwa go rona go tswa mo gare ga ba losika lwa rona, a re bitsa gore re obamele Allah fela, mme re ne ra mo gana le go mo sotla.
Re ne ra ipoka re re, 'Ke mang yo o nonofileng go re feta?' mme ra tswelela mo boikgogomosong jwa rona le mo kobamelong ya medingwana.
Allah o ne a re romela phefo e e bogale e e neng ya foka masigo a le supa le malatsi a le robedi, e senya sengwe le sengwe.
Re ne re le batho ba ‘Ada, baagi ba Irame, mme phelelo ya rona e ne ya nna tlhagiso mo go botlhe ba ba neng ba tla morago ga rona.

trial.label: Kotlhao e e neng ya romelwa mo go bone e ne e le efe?
options: Go thunya go go kwa godimo

location.label: Leina la motse wa bone wa tlhamane ke eng?

outcome.label: Kwa bofelong ba ne ba felela ka eng?
options: Di ne tsa senngwa mme masalela a tsone a nna thuto .
Ba ne ba fetolwa go nna ditshwene
Ba ne ba nwela mo lewatleng
Ba ne ba fitlhwa ka fa tlase ga go relela ga lefatshe
outcome.answer: Di ne tsa senngwa mme masalela a tsone a nna thuto .

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
